750230201.text: #Look, look, {NICKNAME}! There's a Kamera here, and some props too. D'you think this is a film set?

750230202.text: But these houses... they're so tiny. They make you look like a giant!

750230206.text: Hehe, looks like we're real "big" shots now, huh?

750230239.text: Suddenly, yet utterly seamlessly, a Natlan local joins the conversation...

750230209.text: Oh, hello! Are you guys interested in filmmaking too? If so, then I beseech you — join forces with me, Akatanga, to bring this burgeoning new trend to the lands of Natlan, that it might sweep all before it!

750230211.text: #How come you're so hyped all of a sudden, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Anyone'd think you were a film buff yourself, chiming in like that!

750230213.text: You have a keen eye, little one! In truth, everything you see here was set up with the sole intention of making a certain little Tepetlisaur the next big star!

750230214.text: A great pity that my friend took the little fellow away. We had an almighty spat over our creative differences, after which she stormed off with my most important actor... and now they are gone. *sigh*...

750230215.text: I should never have mixed friends and business. The project failed, and I lost my friend too... In other words, I am doubly defeated.

750230216.text: But that's all water under the bridge — for now, what stands before me but another little Tepetlisaur, starry-eyed and eager for stardom! With such enthusiasm, what could go wrong? We shall make the next big hit!

750230217.text: So, what do you say? If you can help me complete this timeless, groundbreaking work of mine, I'll be sure to reward you handsomely!

750230208.text: Seriously, what are you on about? There's no way Paimon could live in such a small house. She couldn't even stretch her arms and legs out!

subQuests.subQuestName: Place the Wooden Barrel somewhere suitable

750230301.text: What's up? Need me to run you through it once more?

750230303.text: First, set out the performance props. Place the Wooden Barrel in the <color=#00E1FFFF>middle of the scene, without blocking the main character or the set</color>, and place the Elemental Bait near <color=#00E1FFFF>where the antagonist enters from</color>.

750230304.text: When it's time to do so, <color=#00E1FFFF>guide the antagonist to a spot near the Wooden Barrel</color>, then move back to a safe position and <color=#00E1FFFF>smash the Wooden Barrel</color>.

750230306.text: Then best of luck, I'm counting on you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Place the Elemental Bait somewhere suitable

750230501.text: When the actors are in position, the two of you must <color=#00E1FFFF>guide the antagonist towards the Wooden Barrel</color> as planned, then scram with equal haste. Once you've reached a safe position, simply <color=#00E1FFFF>smash the Wooden Barrel</color>.

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait for your Saurian companion to get in position
Get into position at the designated spot
Get into position at the designated spot

750231201.text: Hey! Why's a temp suddenly filling in as the antagonist? Nobody ran it by us!

750231202.text: Shh! Quiet, we're about to start shooting!

750231203.text: "No, such evil cannot be forgiven... rest in peace, my friends. Oh, the agony... Seeing the fallen brothers of the tribe, how can one not be moved to tears?"

750231204.text: "But now is not the time for tears. Today, I face the all-scor{RUBY#[D]Xolotl}ching emissary, and come what may, I shall have my revenge—"

750231206.text: A ferocious, toothless beast whose demeanor is as cool and composed as a Lavender Melon, that legendary fruit from far across the sea!

750231207.text: What sort of a face was it, I hear you ask? A visage of such merciless cruelty that even gulping down volcanically spicy Tatacos would leave it unmoved. Truly terrifying...

750231208.text: "This time, this time your remorse shall be great indeed!" And with that, the giant beast with the red tail scarf unleashed the Mighty Meaty Fireball it had honed through countless hours of practice...

750231209.text: Alright, now's the time! Lure the Electro Slime towards the Wooden Barrel, then smash it to smithereens!

750231210.text: What, just smash a barrel? How's that gonna make anyone buy this whole "Mighty Meaty Fireball" business?

750231211.text: Sounds kinda weird, but... If you say so, we'll give it a try.

subQuests.subQuestName: Lure the antagonist near the barrel, and smash the barrel

750230702.text: Steady on, no need to rush!

750230703.text: To tell you the truth, I was just a teeny-tiny bit worried for the little one just now. I wanted the effect to be as realistic as possible, so I might have gone a bit overboard on the explosives...

750230708.text: In any case, with this experience to go on, I'll know how to do things better next time. Thank you all for your help. Now, how about we take a look at how it turned out?

750230709.text: To all of your surprise, neither the savior with the red tail scarf, nor the evil crackling antagonist, nor the thrilling shots of explosions seem to have made it into the final cut — only close-ups of Akatanga's constantly changing expressions...

750230710.text: I... I'm the star of the show?

750230707.text: Yeah! What if someone got hurt, or there was a fire or something?

750230801.text: No, that won't do. It didn't turn out how I imagined at all... Let's start over.

750232001.text: Who knows, perhaps that friend of mine might even have a change of heart once she sees this... Haha.
